text:
To convert a full English weekday name to its corresponding integer day-of-week number (with Sunday as 0, Monday as 1, etc., up to Saturday as 6), we can use a list of day names and find the index of the given day name. This implementation is case-insensitive.

Confidence Level: 95%

```python
def day_number(day_name):
    days = [
        "Sunday",
        "Monday",
        "Tuesday",
        "Wednesday",
        "Thursday",
        "Friday",
        "Saturday",
    ]
    try:
        return days.index(day_name.strip().title())
    except ValueError:
        return None
```
